sources.title: BTech Fee Structure for AY 2026-27
sources.publisher: IIT Bhilai - Office of the Assistant Registrar (Students' Affairs)

scholarships.name: Merit-cum-Means (MCM) Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Open to General/OBC-category BTech students with combined parental income under Rs 5 lakh (General) or Rs 6 lakh (OBC); merit is judged by JEE rank in semester one and by CGPA (6.0+, no F grade) afterward. Capped at 25% of each batch.
scholarships.benefit: Tuition is waived in full for income under Rs 1 lakh, with Rs 1,000/month pocket money for 10 months; the Rs 1-5 lakh band gets a two-thirds waiver plus the same stipend; the OBC Rs 5-6 lakh band gets only the full waiver.

scholarships.name: Institute SC/ST Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Open to SC/ST-category BTech students with combined parental income up to Rs 4.5 lakh; merit is judged by JEE rank in the first semester and by CGPA (6.0+, no F grade) in later semesters.
scholarships.benefit: Basic mess and hostel boarding charges are reimbursed in full, plus a pocket-money stipend of Rs 250 per month.

scholarships.name: Institute Free Studentship (IFS)
scholarships.eligibility: Open to General/OBC BTech students under the same income bands and merit rule as the MCM award (up to Rs 5 lakh General, Rs 6 lakh OBC); limited to 10% of each admitted batch.
scholarships.benefit: Only the tuition fee is waived, on the same income-tiered scale as MCM (up to two-thirds for the Rs 1-5 lakh band); it carries no monthly stipend.

scholarships.name: Institute Fellowship for PG Students
scholarships.eligibility: Open to non-sponsored M.Tech admits holding a valid GATE score, and to PhD scholars who receive an institute fellowship offer; recipients must be campus-resident in any funded semester.
scholarships.benefit: M.Tech scholars draw the fellowship for up to 21 months; PhD scholars draw it for 4 years, extendable a 5th year on a positive department review, against 8 hours/week of assigned academic or admin work.

scholarships.name: GeetAmal Ghosh-Roy Award
scholarships.eligibility: A single first-year BTech student whose combined parental income is Rs 4.5 lakh or less; donor-funded by Dr. Rana Ghosh-Roy from the 2018-19 session onward.
scholarships.benefit: A one-time cash award of Rs 50,000, paid to the recipient in two installments.

scholarships.name: P.K Jain Memorial Award
scholarships.eligibility: A BTech student who has completed at least four semesters and has made a notable contribution to the institute's advancement; donor-funded by Smt. Sharda Jain from the 2018-19 session onward.
scholarships.benefit: A cash prize of Rs 50,000 together with a gold-plated silver medal.
